The values present in the CSV files contained in this folder have been extracted from Figures in the original paper [1] using [PlotDigitizer](https://plotdigitizer.com/app).

[1] F. De Putter, S. Eissa, and H. Corporaal, “POQ: Is There a Pareto-Optimal Quantization Strategy for Deep Neural Networks?,” IEEE Access, vol. 13, pp. 81434–81449, 2025, doi: 10.1109/ACCESS.2025.356704
